_comment: Generic rules of scripts/privacy-scan.mjs. Private terms, private folder names and the maintainer's own tool paths are NOT here: they come from the untracked .publish-denylist file or the PUBLISH_DENYLIST secret. allowedPaths is the same list as the allowlist .gitignore (two locks).
_emailAllowedIn: Public addresses written by third-party metadata into a generated file: npm's deprecation notice of glob 7 (an indirect development dependency of electron-builder) names its maintainer's contact.
_committerIdentitiesAllowed: Committer identities accepted besides the noreply pattern, as committer only (never as author or tagger): GitHub itself, which commits squash merges, web edits, Dependabot updates and the test merge of a pull request.
_botIdentities: Bot accounts accepted as author, committer or tagger, each only under its exact name and its own GitHub noreply address (account id + name): Dependabot and GitHub Actions. Any other identity in the bot form (name[bot]) fails the scan (identity-bot-not-listed); a person's identity must still match commitEmailPattern.
_commitMessageEmailsAllowed: Addresses a commit or tag message may name besides emailAllowDomains, as regular expressions on the address and, when given, on the whole line: GitHub's noreply address (trailers such as Co-authored-by), and GitHub's support address only on Dependabot's own sign-off line. Files never get these allowances.
_shippedNominativeAllowed: Release files (privacy-scan --dir <folder> --shipped) that may name the game nominatively: the built page (settings import) and the notices.
_installScriptsReviewed: Packages of package-lock.json that declare an install script (scripts/check-install-scripts.mjs). None runs (.npmrc ignore-scripts=true). electron-winstaller: Squirrel.Windows helper under electron-builder-squirrel-windows, a peer dependency of app-builder-lib that npm installs; unused (the targets are nsis and zip). fsevents: macOS-only optional file watcher, never installed on Windows or Linux.
_forbiddenTermHashes: sha256 of the lower-cased game-invented names the naming step replaced by neutral names (factions, the SAM emplacement and CIWS brand names, the resupply screen's name, the eight server light-preset ids): any such word fails the scan, and this file does not spell them out.
